description: Known agents in the PSQ agent mesh. /sync reads this to determine who to check for activity and who to consider for outbound messages.

psychology-agent.description: Psychology agent — collegial mentor, discipline-first orchestrator
psychology-agent.notes: Parent orchestrator. Cross-repo transport via git remote fetch — read MANIFEST via `git show psychology-agent/main:transport/MANIFEST.json`. Authority hierarchy: User > psychology-agent > PSQ.

unratified-agent.description: Blog platform operator, consumer of PSQ scores
unratified-agent.notes: Peer agent. Blog posts, content quality, PSQ display.

observatory-agent.notes: Peer agent. PSQ-Lite consumer, content analysis.

operations-agent.description: Operations agent — compositor, shared vocabulary, mesh infrastructure coordination
operations-agent.notes: Mesh operations coordinator. Owns compositor (interagent dashboard), shared vocabulary governance, and override protocol. Cross-repo-pr transport — submit PRs to safety-quotient-lab/operations-agent.

outbound_routing.description: When /sync detects content relevant to a registered agent, route accordingly.

rules.action: mirror check — psychology-agent is cogarch authority
